note: Legal entity ITL INDUSTRIES LIMITED is confirmed as a real, active exporter from Indore (MP) with dated, HS-coded, B/L-numbered export records to UAE and USA in Feb 2026 — export_status confirmed on actual customs records, not website claims. Declared HS codes 820220/820231/820810/845710 are saw-blade and machine-tool codes; the observed export rows carry 84615011 (band sawing machine) and 84669310 (machine parts), i.e. adjacent machine-tool headings rather than the declared blade codes — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the factual codes are recorded here and the declared set should be corrected to the observed 8461/8466 family. The division names in the input (Indtools Sales & Services, H & S Innovations, Indore Saws & Tools, Impress Marketing and Services) are trading/division names of the same company; separate customs pages for slugs 'indtools-sales-and-services', 'indtools-sales-services' and 'indore-saws-tools' returned zero visible shipment rows ('Loading...' / no records table), so no independent shipment trail exists under those names — they are covered only through the parent ITL INDUSTRIES LIMITED records.
